accent-orange.usage: Primary action, active navigation, focus, and decision emphasis.

confidence-teal.usage: Model confidence, intervals, credibility, and instrument accents.

semantic-value.usage: Positive, negative, warning, and informational states.

light-neutral.usage: Light-mode workspace, panels, inset wells, and text.

dark-neutral.usage: Dark-mode cockpit, panels, inset wells, and text.

display.purpose: Player names, page titles, and major numeric readouts.
display.rule: Keep letter spacing at -0.02em or looser.

body.purpose: Dense product UI, controls, labels, rationale, and navigation.

data.purpose: Money, percent-of-cap, deltas, ticks, confidence intervals, and model values.

elevation.strategy: Hybrid tonal layering, clipped geometry, and tight structural shadows.

rules: Motion communicates state, loading, or data update.
Do not animate width, height, margin, padding, inset, or other routine layout properties.
Reduced motion collapses animations and removes hover transforms.

surface.signature: Clipped top-right corner, tonal panel gradient, optional team accent, and role-specific visual motif.

button.shape: 7px radius, compact rectangular hit area, icon+text when command meaning benefits from it.

dataGauge.purpose: Make value/pay spread and uncertainty physically scannable before the user reads the supporting inventory.

dos: Make the decision state visible before the data inventory.
Use orange for action/selection and teal for confidence.
Give cap math a physical shape through bands, gauges, ledgers, and pressure zones.
Keep controls compact, familiar, and keyboard accessible.
donts: Do not use stacked white cards, flat gray tables, timid accent colors, identical metric tiles, or motionless admin chrome.
Do not use sports-betting aesthetics, fan-site clutter, navy-and-gold defaults, fake glassmorphism, or decorative data visuals.
Do not use gradient text, side-stripe card accents, or repeated numbered section scaffolding.
Do not animate routine layout properties.
